PASS WITH NOTES — performance/265, exact head 6b6419caadafa5b0926c8df92550ce39dc6116ff, base 01b363e3 (#264).

Reissued round-1 performance verdict after rebase-only confirmation. Detached worktree HEAD equals the requested full SHA. Executed git range-diff dba0c080..9e665af8 01b363e3..6b6419caadafa5b0926c8df92550ce39dc6116ff: one commit maps 9e665af8 to 6b6419ca; only docs/difficulties.md surrounding context differs (D-F215-1 now precedes D-F213-2). No production or test patch-content change. Original exact-head review and embedded baseline: output 85f8a68ce7d61f89593f021634eb2c07299cca79, community/roles/performance/outputs/2026-11/19-verdict-pr-265-9e665af.dd.json.

Cost conclusion unchanged: zero incremental launches, process observations, polls or timers. Under !same_launch, route.anchor.or(descriptor.proc) is selected by value and checked once against at most 31 already-verified ancestors. One optional fixed-size ProcIdentity per route; no growing sibling/restart history or per-tick/per-seat work. Existing route serialization acquires bounded extra fields on a carried seat, with absent anchors omitted. The observer/walk and launch-site inventory remain unchanged by this PR. Existing macOS ancestry validation's cached /bin/ps reads are pre-existing, not a launch-free claim about all registration.

Original before-only baseline remains historical, not remeasured or relabeled as this head's runtime proof: PID17600 running dba0c0803b, 2026-11-19T08:18:57.096917Z–08:19:17.359234Z, 20.262 s, counters 655→655/all by_op deltas zero, machine 115.8 launches/s, CPU snapshot 63.7%, RSS 156992 KiB. F222 separately measured that old daemon's CPU-time slope at 31.86%; this is not attributed to the anchor patch.

Note owed remains post-deployment counters, whole-machine spawn rate and CPU/RSS paired with sibling restart live-proof timestamps. No performance code change requested. No builds, tests, mutations, restarts or configuration changes performed for this confirmation.
